bound_party: Taxable persons established in Belgium supplying goods or services to another VAT-identified taxable person. Excluded by the law itself: taxable persons subject to the flat-rate scheme of Article 56 of the VAT Code, and bankrupt taxable persons.
threshold_definition: No size test. The obligation binds every established taxable person in scope regardless of turnover or headcount, which makes Belgium the strictest of the 2026 cohort for small companies — there is no small-company deferral to wait for.
format_version: 3.0.21 mandatory on the Peppol network from 2026-08-17
format_note: The law requires a structured electronic form permitting automatic processing and compliant with EN 16931-1 and CEN/TS 16931-2. The implementing royal decree sets Peppol BIS Billing in UBL syntax, transmitted over the Peppol network, as the default standard; parties may agree an alternative format provided it still complies with the European standard. The version figure is the OpenPeppol release calendar, verified separately at docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/release-notes/ — Peppol BIS Billing 3.0.21 was published 2026-05-20 and became mandatory 2026-08-17, superseding 3.0.20. Belgian law does not itself name a Peppol version, so the version moves on OpenPeppol's schedule, not Belgium's.
tolerance_note: Penalty tolerance only — not a postponement of the obligation. FPS Finance will not apply penalties for offences relating to the new e-invoicing obligation during the first three months of 2026 where the enterprise can show it took reasonable steps to comply, including where it lacks the technical means to send structured electronic invoices or its software cannot yet issue a valid one. FPS Finance states explicitly that "under no circumstances" will a general postponement be granted.
legal_instrument: Loi du 6 février 2024 modifiant le Code de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée et le Code des impôts sur les revenus 1992 en ce qui concerne l'introduction de l'obligation de facturation électronique, amending Article 53 of the VAT Code (Moniteur belge, 20 February 2024, numac 2024001635).

tolerance_note: Same penalty tolerance as the issuing duty. FPS Finance names inability to receive structured electronic invoices as a covered offence for the first three months of 2026. The obligation itself is not postponed.

bound_party: Domestic entrepreneurs issuing an invoice for a supply to another domestic entrepreneur's business, whose total turnover (Gesamtumsatz, § 19 Abs. 2 UStG) in the preceding calendar year exceeded EUR 800,000.
threshold_basis: Gesamtumsatz as defined in § 19 Abs. 2 UStG, of the entrepreneur issuing the invoice.
threshold_definition: § 27 Abs. 38 UStG extends the tolerance to 31 December 2027 only "wenn der Gesamtumsatz (§ 19 Absatz 2) des die Rechnung ausstellenden Unternehmers im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr nicht mehr als 800 000 Euro" betragen hat. This row is the cohort that fails that test, i.e. prior-year turnover above EUR 800,000, for whom the tolerance ends a year earlier.

Another format may be agreed between the parties if the UStG-required data can be extracted correctly and completely from it, which keeps EDI procedures such as EDIFACT usable.
tolerance_note: From 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026 any issuer may issue a "sonstige Rechnung" instead of an e-invoice. Paper is always permitted; another electronic format such as a PDF by e-mail requires the recipient's consent. Separately, a non-conforming EDI procedure may be used until 31 December 2027 even by this cohort (BMF FAQ Q11).

regime_label: Facturación electrónica obligatoria entre empresarios y profesionales
bound_party: Empresarios y profesionales whose volume of operations exceeded EUR 8,000,000 in the immediately preceding calendar year.
threshold_basis: Volumen de operaciones calculated in accordance with article 121 of Ley 37/1992 (the Spanish VAT Act)
threshold_period: el año natural inmediato anterior — the immediately preceding calendar year
threshold_definition: Disposición final cuarta of Real Decreto 238/2026 phases the regime from the entry into force of the ministerial order developing the public invoicing solution: 12 months for empresarios y profesionales whose volume of operations, calculated per article 121 of Ley 37/1992, exceeded EUR 8,000,000 in the immediately preceding calendar year; 24 months for everyone else. Unlike Poland's fixed 2024 reference year, this is a rolling prior-year test.
format_name: UBL (reference syntax for the public solution)
format_note: Real Decreto 238/2026 permits CII, UBL, EDIFACT and Facturae. For the public invoicing solution specifically, UBL is the reference syntax: Anexo I of Orden HAC/1028/2026 is titled "Contenido y estructura de los campos de la factura electrónica conforme al modelo UBL y la EN 16931". No UBL version number is stated in the order's Anexo I heading as read, so the version is an open unknown rather than an omission.
legal_instrument: Ley 18/2022, de 28 de septiembre, de creación y crecimiento de empresas, art. 12 (amending art. 2 bis of Ley 56/2007); Real Decreto 238/2026, de 25 de marzo (BOE-A-2026-7295), disposición final cuarta; Orden HAC/1028/2026, de 2 de octubre (BOE-A-2026-20587), disposición final única.

Any competitor snapshot taken before 5 October 2026 still shows Spain as undated.

regime_label: Facturation électronique — domestic B2B e-invoicing reform
bound_party: Grandes entreprises and entreprises de taille intermédiaire (ETI), plus any company that opted into the reform early. DGFiP: "À compter du 1er septembre 2026, les grandes entreprises et les entreprises de taille intermédiaire..."
threshold_basis: Headcount leg of the PME test in article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354; must be read together with threshold_definition, because the real boundary is composite.
threshold_period: the last closed accounting year, per the company-size categories of décret n° 2008-1354
threshold_definition: In scope if the company is NOT a PME within the meaning of article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354. A PME employs fewer than 250 persons AND has either annual turnover not exceeding EUR 50 million or a balance-sheet total not exceeding EUR 43 million. So this row applies if the company employs 250 or more persons, OR employs fewer than 250 but exceeds both EUR 50 million turnover and EUR 43 million balance-sheet total. The headcount and financial tests are cumulative within the PME definition; the two financial criteria are alternatives to each other. Encoding this as a bare "250 employees" rule would wrongly exempt a 200-person company with EUR 60m turnover and a EUR 50m balance sheet.
format_note: Factur-X, UBL and CII are the permitted structured formats; versions are not stated in the DGFiP guide read for this row. See unknowns.
legal_instrument: Ordonnance n° 2021-1190 du 15 septembre 2021, as amended; company-size categories per article 3 of décret n° 2008-1354 du 18 décembre 2008.

regime_label: Electronic invoicing via the Sistema di Interscambio (SdI)
bound_party: Taxpayers applying the Italian flat-rate regime (regime forfetario, L. 190/2014 art. 1 cc. 54–89) who were not already required to issue electronic invoices from 1 July 2022 — i.e. those whose revenue or fees in the preceding year, pro-rated to a full year, did not exceed EUR 25,000.
threshold_basis: Ricavi conseguiti ovvero compensi percepiti, ragguagliati ad anno (revenue earned or fees received, pro-rated to a full year).
threshold_period: the year preceding the relevant commencement date
threshold_definition: DL 36/2022 art. 18 c. 3 brought the obligation forward to 1 July 2022 for forfetario taxpayers who "nell'anno precedente abbiano conseguito ricavi ovvero percepito compensi, ragguagliati ad anno, superiori a euro 25.000". This row is the residual cohort at or below that figure, for whom the obligation runs from 1 January 2024 "a prescindere dall'entità dei ricavi conseguiti o compensi percepiti" — irrespective of revenue. So the threshold selects the commencement date, and from 1 January 2024 it no longer screens anyone out.

regime_label: National e-Invoice System (KSeF — Krajowy System e-Faktur)
bound_party: VAT taxpayers whose sales value including the tax amount exceeded PLN 200,000,000 in 2024.
threshold_basis: Sales value including the tax amount (wartość sprzedaży wraz z kwotą podatku)
threshold_period: calendar year 2024 — a fixed historical year, not a rolling period
threshold_definition: The portal gates the first phase on sales exceeding "200 mln zł" in 2024. Because the reference year is fixed at 2024, a company cannot fall out of this phase by shrinking in 2025: whoever was above the line in 2024 is in the February cohort permanently.
format_note: FA_RR(1) applies to agricultural invoices from April 2026.
legal_instrument: Ustawa z dnia 5 sierpnia 2025 r. o zmianie ustawy o podatku od towarów i usług (Dz. U. 2025 poz. 1203).

regime_label: National e-Invoice System (KSeF — Krajowy System e-Faktur)
bound_party: All remaining VAT taxpayers — those whose 2024 sales value including the tax amount did not exceed PLN 200,000,000.
threshold_basis: Sales value including the tax amount (wartość sprzedaży wraz z kwotą podatku)
threshold_period: calendar year 2024 — a fixed historical year, not a rolling period
threshold_definition: The residual cohort: everyone not caught by the PLN 200 million 2024 test. The portal describes this phase as "all remaining entrepreneurs" from 1 April 2026, subject to the PLN 10,000/month small-invoice transition recorded in tolerance_ends.
format_note: FA_RR(1) applies to agricultural invoices from April 2026.
tolerance_note: Small-invoice transition running to 31 December 2026. A taxpayer otherwise obliged to issue structured invoices may still issue electronic or paper invoices in a given month where the total value of sales including tax documented by those invoices is PLN 10,000 or less. Cash registers and fiscal receipts bearing the purchaser's NIP — treated as simplified invoices, up to PLN 450 or EUR 100 — also remain usable to 31 December 2026, as does the deferral of the duty to quote KSeF numbers in B2B payments.
legal_instrument: Ustawa z dnia 5 sierpnia 2025 r. o zmianie ustawy o podatku od towarów i usług (Dz. U. 2025 poz. 1203).
source_title: "Podstawy prawne oraz kluczowe terminy" — legal basis and key dates, Ministry of Finance KSeF portal (ksef.podatki.gov.pl)
confidence_note: Read directly on 2026-10-07: the 1 April 2026 date for remaining taxpayers, and the PLN 10,000 monthly small-invoice transition expiring at the end of 2026.
unknowns: Whether the PLN 10,000 monthly test is applied per month independently (so a taxpayer can move in and out of the transition month to month) or is forfeited permanently once breached is not stated on the portal page read.
notes: Out of scope per the portal: B2C invoices (voluntary), foreign entities with no Polish seat or fixed establishment, invoices under OSS, IOSS and the SME exemption, certain transport and toll services, and self-invoicing where a party lacks a Polish NIP.

regime_label: National e-Invoice System (KSeF — Krajowy System e-Faktur)
bound_party: All VAT taxpayers in Poland, regardless of size.
threshold_definition: No size test. The Ministry of Finance states receiving via KSeF is mandatory from 1 February 2026 "regardless of company size", which is two months before the small-taxpayer issuing duty starts.
format_note: FA(3) is the logical structure for standard invoices. A separate FA_RR(1) structure applies to agricultural invoices from April 2026.
legal_instrument: Ustawa z dnia 5 sierpnia 2025 r. o zmianie ustawy o podatku od towarów i usług (Dz. U. 2025 poz. 1203), amending the Polish VAT Act.

notes: The asymmetry here is the commercially important fact: a small Polish company is in scope for receiving on 1 February 2026, two months before the headline "April 2026" issuing date that most summaries lead with.

regime_label: RO e-Factura — national electronic invoicing system
bound_party: Economic operators — taxable persons established in Romania — during the initial reporting phase, required to report all invoices into the RO e-Factura system.
